other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale, or five times the annual rate of duty payable on the grant of the licence or which would have been so payable if it had been taken out for a period of twelve months, whichever is the greater.

Section 36(2) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994 provides an additional liability of one-twelfth of the appropriate annual rate of vehicle excise duty for each month, or part thereof, in the relevant period will be imposed by the court.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex section 47
